create_seamless_interaction_fs: create a SeamlessInteractionFS instance to access the Seamless Interaction dataset from S3 and HuggingFace
sample_random_file_ids: sample random file IDs from the Seamless Interaction dataset with optional label, split, and vendor filters
get_interaction_pairs: get interaction pairs from the Seamless Interaction dataset using specific keys or auto-sampling
download_batch_from_hf: download and extract batch archives from HuggingFace with parallel processing
check_movement_v4_availability: check which movement_v4 features are available for a given file ID on S3
